mapper.update: UPDATE store_platform_settings s JOIN provider_webhook_inbox i ON s.id = i.resolved_setting_id AND s.connection_revision = i.resolved_setting_revision SET s.last_webhook_at = GREATEST(COALESCE(s.last_webhook_at, i.received_at), i.received_at) WHERE i.id = #{inboxId}

UPDATE store_platform_settings s JOIN provider_webhook_inbox i ON s.id = i.resolved_setting_id AND s.connection_revision = i.resolved_setting_revision SET s.last_success_at = CASE WHEN i.status = 'PROCESSED' THEN GREATEST(COALESCE(s.last_success_at, i.processed_at), i.processed_at) ELSE s.last_success_at END, s.last_error_code = i.last_error_code, s.connection_status = CASE WHEN i.status = 'PROCESSED' THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE s.connection_status END WHERE i.id = #{inboxId} AND i.status IN ('PROCESSED', 'RETRYABLE_FAILED', 'BLOCKED')
